Class SDEPipebuffer

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.simulator.SDE
      • threepl.simulator.SDEPipebuffer
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Cloneable, TDEConstants, Constant, SimTypes

    public class SDEPipebuffer
extends SDE
    The SDEPipebuffer class implements the TDEType.PIPEBUFFER TDE in the threepl simulator.
